summary: add local-path addon to minikube start
pull_request_body: The devcontainer's minikube starts without the local-path StorageClass, so seven PVCs across the infra, gitea, monitoring and otel stacks stay Pending. This change adds --addons=storage-provisioner-rancher to the minikube start command in _start_minikube, so the class exists from the first start. The flag follows the pattern of --cni=calico added by #990. No new code is built; minikube's own addon provides the rancher local-path provisioner that the homelab runs.
why: #2570: the devcontainer's minikube starts with no local-path StorageClass, so every PVC that names it stays Pending and the services that mount them cannot start.
what_changes: Add --addons=storage-provisioner-rancher to the minikube start command in _start_minikube
Update k8s/README.md to state that devops devcontainer enables the addon automatically
Add a unit test that asserts the start command includes the addon flag
feasibility: The issue premise is confirmed by the start command in src/devops_cli/commands/k8s/cluster_runtime.py (_start_minikube), which passes --driver=docker --cni=calico but no --addons flag.
The k8s/README.md Prerequisites section states that devops devcontainer does not enable the storage-provisioner-rancher addon.

Seven PVC files in the repository name local-path: k8s/devops/roadmap-service/pvc.yaml, k8s/gitea/values.yaml, k8s/monitoring/grafana-values.yaml, k8s/monitoring/k8s-monitoring-values.yaml, k8s/monitoring/prometheus-values.yaml, k8s/monitoring/pyroscope-values.yaml, k8s/otel/tempo-values.yaml.
First check the implementation runs: uv run devops ci test tests/test_k8s_cluster_runtime.py to verify the start command includes the addon flag.
Second check: uv run devops ci test to run the full test suite and confirm no regression.
existing_tool: minikube's storage-provisioner-rancher addon provides the local-path StorageClass with the rancher local-path provisioner. It is listed in minikube v1.39.0 addons list. No new code is built.

added.name: minikube start enables local-path storage
added.text: The _start_minikube function SHALL pass --addons=storage-provisioner-rancher to the minikube start command, so the cluster has a StorageClass named local-path from the first start.

scenarios.name: Start command includes the addon flag
scenarios.when: _start_minikube constructs the argument list for the minikube start subprocess call
scenarios.then: the argument list includes the string --addons=storage-provisioner-rancher

groups.title: Add storage-provisioner-rancher addon to minikube start
groups.test: Write a test in tests/test_k8s_cluster_runtime.py that mocks subprocess.run, calls _start_minikube, and asserts the arguments list passed to minikube start includes --addons=storage-provisioner-rancher alongside --driver=docker and --cni=calico
groups.implementation: In _start_minikube in src/devops_cli/commands/k8s/cluster_runtime.py, add the string --addons=storage-provisioner-rancher to the list of arguments passed to the minikube start subprocess call, next to the existing --driver=docker and --cni=calico flags
groups.documentation: Update k8s/README.md Prerequisites: replace the sentence that says devops devcontainer does not enable the addon and the manual minikube addons enable instruction with a statement that devops devcontainer post-start enables the storage-provisioner-rancher addon automatically
groups.verify: uv run devops ci test tests/test_k8s_cluster_runtime.py
